agent.name: Emerging Technology Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: SubAgent7 - dated contextual landscape intelligence and monitoring triggers

analytical_question: As of2026-11-16, which alternatives and ecosystem developments matter for this proposed application over the next30days, and what original evidence should trigger reassessment?
general_et_finding: As of2026-11-16, agentic AI spans an active but uneven tool/ecosystem landscape. S1 supplies a dated April2026 peak-expectation interpretation, not proof of November task maturity; S6 emphasizes control and cost questions. S2 describes vendor assistance, S3 an integration protocol. S4 is inactive September8 software-task data, not a current model ranking or chart-task result. Category attention, interoperability and measured application value remain separate evidence questions.
application_finding: The relevant chart-review alternatives are the existing human review with deterministic source checks, constrained model assistance, eligible native BI assistance and a human-supervised agent workflow. Source tables/semantic definitions, source traces, evaluation data and integration protocols are complements rather than interchangeable complete products. S2 describes partial BI assistance, not validated chart checking. S4 software-task evidence does not qualify chart interpretation. Compare error consequences and complete setup/review/correction/support/exit effort on the same defined task; no local comparative result is supplied.
organization_specific_finding: AUTHORIZED_LEARNING_COMPARISON_PRIORITY as of2026-11-16. KEEP_BASELINE: the manual/deterministic comparator. COMPARE_IF_AUTHORIZED: the stipulated permitted public/synthetic chart learning scope can prioritize source-trace quality, false corrections, full effort and exit/portability. WATCH: native BI only if an actual relevant tenant appears; no paid BI capacity is supplied. Reduced disclosure exposure does not upgrade general maturity or prove task value. Most consequential signal now is the local same-task comparison, rather than removing the primary firm’s route blocker.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Current organizational profiles, permissions and stress headlines are fictional teaching premises; no real firm audit, executed pilot or field measurement is asserted.

Analyst interpretation, vendor documentation, protocol text, empirical research and public guidance have different evidential roles. S1/S6 share a publisher, so they are not independent empirical confirmations.
No current model leader, scoped application adoption denominator, exact contracted price, measured ROI or new finance-law finding is established.
Current outputs are reasoned and authored by this same assistant; local code serializes content and checks saved artifacts, not an independent model/evaluator.

A small specifically authorized public/synthetic investigation may be worth learning from without waiting for every production arrangement; it still needs its own authority/review and cannot establish sustained release.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Confidence in source scope distinctions and conditional reasoning exceeds confidence in current vendor/model rankings or local business value. Verified source dates are retained; undated mutable documents and inactive observations limit recency. No numeric confidence, universal readiness score or model reliability estimate is invented.
value_opportunity_implication: Possible improvement must beat an adequate baseline on task quality and complete effort at the same scope. No local quality result, workload, applicable quote or ROI is supplied; cheaper model usage alone cannot establish net savings.
risk_governance_implication: An open protocol or product announcement cannot authorize data/tool access. Preserve the stipulated allowed scope, human review/publication or merge authority, source provenance, stop/fallback and evidence refresh. Qualified humans decide actual obligations and operating release.
recommendation_management_implication: AUTHORIZED_LEARNING_COMPARISON_PRIORITY — For the stipulated learning permission, prioritize a proportionate source-linked comparison of manual/deterministic, constrained-model and agent assistance, including total effort and portability. Do not buy a native BI platform just because it is on a trend list. Preserve the provided permission/owner/cover; no broader data use, publication or routine release follows. Send measured results, if later obtained, to Adoption/readiness review.
change_monitoring_triggers: M1: Exact allowed data/model/tool route and accountable review/stop authority. Owner: Proposed sponsor and security/data authority with service owner. Cadence: Immediately on a decision/change and before any execution. Evidence: Actual scope-specific approval/denial and accepted owner/cover record. Trigger: Previously blocked route becomes explicitly permitted, or existing permission/cover is withdrawn. Action: Reopen eligible comparison options or halt dependent evaluation; return authority/readiness questions to humans/SubAgent6.

M2: Vendor feature surface, release status, eligibility and complete current terms. Owner: Proposed platform owner and procurement/finance role. Cadence: Every14days; next planned check2026-11-30, and immediately before use/commitment. Evidence: Original dated/current vendor docs, actual tenant settings/capacity/region and applicable quote/terms. Trigger: Material feature/eligibility/deprecation/terms change or stale unverified quote. Action: Refresh the comparison; suspend dependent availability/price claims until confirmed. Never infer chart validation from report assistance.

M3: Protocol revision, security notice and actual host/server behavior. Owner: Proposed IT integration/security owner. Cadence: Monthly; next planned check2026-12-16, and on a security or integration change. Evidence: Original revision/release/security notice plus exact-version consent/access/log/compatibility test. Trigger: Relevant incompatible revision, access behavior change or unsupported interface. Action: Reassess integration/exit effort and isolate affected route; a spec publication alone does not require migration or authorize access.

M4: Relevant independent empirical research and its dataset maintenance/date. Owner: Proposed evaluation lead. Cadence: Weekly maintained research-feed review; next planned check2026-11-23; before any model ranking. Evidence: Original methods/data with task population, model/tool version, observation date, coverage and reliability definition. Trigger: A maintained, sufficiently task-matched new result; source becomes inactive or conflicting. Action: Update confidence/test priorities, not automatically a go decision. METR September8 data remain historical even when reopened.

M5: Local comparator performance and complete workflow cost. Owner: Proposed reporting/process owner and evaluation lead. Cadence: Every model/tool/reference/workflow change and before any broadened use. Evidence: Authorized representative source-linked tasks, reference answers, misses/false corrections/abstentions and all setup/review/correction/support/exit effort. Trigger: Pre-agreed material error condition fails, or meaningful full-effort benefit over adequate baseline is demonstrated. Action: Escalate/stop on material failure; otherwise send evidence to Adoption and readiness review. Owners set task-specific tolerances before outcomes.

M6: Analyst attention, investment and broad industry adoption context. Owner: Proposed technology-intelligence owner. Cadence: Quarterly and when a directly relevant new primary observation appears. Evidence: Dated analyst context and original task/industry denominators; distinguish forecasts from observations. Trigger: Evidence actually changes a specified dependency or the available comparator set. Action: Revise only the affected rationale; news volume or generic funding alone does not reopen operating release.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Ask the learning sponsor/evaluation lead for reference answers, materiality, ordinary-reviewer workload, full effort and portability/exit criteria before interpreting an authorized comparison.
No native BI tenant/capacity is supplied: request it only if a native-platform alternative is actually relevant, rather than prescribing procurement to create relevance.
